headline: Names a post office in Smithtown, New York, after former Congressman Bill Carney.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 25 Route 111 in Smithtown, New York, as the Congressman Bill Carney Post Office. It is a naming measure only. It does not change how mail is handled, what services the office offers, or who works there.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on August 21, 2019.
